svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 03/12 The Bay from Above (Rare)
svg.desc: Climb the fire trails at sunset and the whole bay lines up, bridge and all. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
